Карты побережий, которых нет ни в одном: Maps of coasts that are in no atlas: bays, capes and lighthouses labelled in a neat hand. They say the cartographer drew them from the tales of sailors who never came back. With it, history reads like a journey.
Партитура для дождя по крыше, водосточно: A score for rain on the roof, the drainpipe and the windowsill. Read in a half-whisper, it makes the hall quieter and the pages turn faster.
Ремёсла, которых больше нет: точильщик о: Crafts that are no more: the cloud sharpener, the echo mender, the dream binder. Each is described so closely that you want to try it.
Записи мастера, который чинил часы на вс: The notes of a master who mended clocks on every tower in the city. He believed time wears out too, and knew how to tighten it.
Неторопливое исследование того, как камн: A leisurely study of how stones wait. The book teaches not to hurry, and the stacks seem to grow brighter with it.
Подробная летопись города, которого не б: A detailed chronicle of a city that never was: its markets, fires, weddings and decrees. Readers argue about where it stood and pay coins to keep the argument going.
Гербарий, в котором уцелела одна страниц: A herbarium in which one page survived, with one pressed leaf. Its caption is longer than any book on plants.
Письма, адресованные тому, кто когда-ниб: Letters addressed to whoever will one day open the book. After reading one, you want to recommend it to a friend.
Пособие по ловле тишины сачком, банкой и: A manual on catching silence with a net, a jar and patience. Short books are remembered for a long time after it.
Роман, в котором нет последней главы. Чи: A novel with no last chapter. Readers finish it in their heads and understand everything else better for it.
Песни, которые пели на переправе, пока п: Songs sung at the crossing while the ferry went from bank to bank. On the road they come to mind by themselves.
Путеводитель по чердакам старых домов: г: A guide to the attics of old houses: where it is dry, where it is warm and where one more shelf can fit.
История одной лестницы от первой ступень: The story of one staircase from the first step to the last: who climbed it and what they dropped. Book suppliers lower their prices after it.
Dream interpretations for those who can't sleep. Long books are easier to read with it, as if the night were shorter.
Ежедневные описи облаков за сто лет одни: Daily inventories of clouds over a hundred years by one and the same observer. Artists leaf through it for hours.
Азбука, которую придумали для птиц: у ка: An alphabet invented for birds: every letter has its own whistle. Letters sounds different beside it.
Дневник библиотекаря, который знал, где: The diary of a librarian who knew where every rare book lay. The notes in the margins hint where to look for more.
Карта улиц, которых нет: переулки между: A map of streets that do not exist: alleys between houses, passages through yards and stairs to the roofs. Books from lending come back along them faster and with a profit.
